name: coauth-PACS-multiplex
description: Multiplex co-authorship hypergraph built from physics publications indexed by the Physics and Astronomy Classification Scheme (PACS). Nodes represent authors. Each hyperedge represents a publication and contains its set of co-authors. Layers correspond to PACS top-level categories (based on the first digit of the PACS code).
